api.command: CLOUDFLARE_INCLUDE_PROCESS_ENV=true npx hush run -t api-workers -- pnpm --filter @slopcade/api dev

metro.comment: Slopcade Metro (port 8085). Can run simultaneously with metro-amen (port 8086).
metro.command: node ../../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --dev-client --port 8085

metro-amen.comment: Amen Metro (port 8086). Can run simultaneously with metro (port 8085).
metro-amen.command: node ../../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8086 npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8086 npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --dev-client --port 8086

ios.comment: Build + install slopcade on iOS simulator. One-shot: exits when done. Starts metro if not running.
ios.command: RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx expo run:ios --no-bundler

ios-amen.comment: Build + install amen on iOS simulator (bundle: games.amen.app).
ios-amen.command: RCT_METRO_PORT=8086 npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && RCT_METRO_PORT=8086 npx expo run:ios --no-bundler

web.command: node ../../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --web --port 8085

web-amen.comment: Amen web (port 8086). Can run simultaneously with web (port 8085).
web-amen.command: node ../../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --web --port 8086

storybook.command: npx hush run -t app -- pnpm storybook
